explain: Installs a command-line tool, like python or git.
Installs a desktop app, like visual-studio-code or google-chrome.
Updates Homebrew's list of available software.
Upgrades all your installed packages, or just one.
example: Getting the newest version of node.
Checking whether python is already installed.
Removing a tool you no longer use.

explain: search finds available software. info shows version details and dependencies.
example: brew info node before installing it.

explain: doctor diagnoses problems and broken links. cleanup deletes old downloads to free up space.
example: When an install fails, run brew doctor first.

syntax:
brew services start <name>
brew services stop <name>
explain: Runs a background tool (like a database) automatically on your Mac, or stops it.
